verdict.rationale: Turso has a public pricing page with named plan tiers (Free, Developer) and a feature comparison grid (e.g., AWS VPC Allow Lists), so plan-level pricing is published. However, none of the evidence shows per-unit rates for compute, storage, or traffic that would let a founder predict a bill. Missing for 10: documented per-unit compute pricing, per-unit storage pricing, per-unit traffic/bandwidth pricing, overage rules, and independent corroboration of bill predictability.
